1. Engagement Scope

The scope of this review is limited to an assessment of Alaris Consulting's compliance with Dodd-Frank Act Section 956 (Incentive Compensation at Financial Institutions); Dodd-Frank §954 (compensation clawback policy requirements); Algorithm-Driven Decision Tools (ADDT) Law (DC). The analysis covers the period from 2022-06-16 to 2024-08-28 and includes a sample of 338 employee records from the Pension Fund Management business unit. Findings are intended for internal management use only.

2. Methodology

ACPWB performed a forensic analysis of payroll and timekeeping data for 338 employees to identify anomalies and patterns indicative of non-compliance with FLSA overtime and meal/rest break requirements.

4. Detailed Findings
WDR-8725-001LOWMONITORING
Observation

Equity grant documentation incomplete for awards issued during the review period

Corrective Action Required

The process for identifying the median employee will be enhanced to include a statistical sampling approach, with the methodology and results documented and presented to the Audit Committee.

Management Response

We concur with the finding. The process has been redesigned, and user acceptance testing is scheduled for the week of 2022-06-16. Full implementation will follow immediately after successful testing.

Owner: Director of Technology Operations • Due: 2022-07-28
WDR-1998-002HIGHDEFERRED
Observation

Compensation equity variance exceeds 15% threshold across protected class segments

Corrective Action Required

The vendor onboarding process will be updated to include a mandatory, risk-based anti-corruption due diligence step for all international third-party intermediaries.

Management Response

Management disputes the risk classification of this finding. While acknowledging the documentation gap, Alaris Consulting believes the underlying practices are compliant with applicable requirements. A formal response memorandum has been filed with the engagement team under separate cover.

Owner: Knowledge Management Specialist • Due: 2022-07-28
WDR-7681-003MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

Final pay for 338 terminated employees in California not provided within the statutory timeframe

Corrective Action Required

The compliance department will develop and implement a risk-based monitoring and testing program for key HR compliance areas, with results reported to the Audit Committee on a quarterly basis.

Management Response

Management has reviewed the finding and determined that the current practice, while inconsistent with the recommendation, is based on a reasonable interpretation of an ambiguous regulation. We will continue to monitor regulatory developments but plan no immediate changes.

Owner: Senior Manager of Marketing Programs • Due: 2022-07-28
WDR-7390-004MEDIUMIN PROGRESS
Observation

FMLA eligibility calculation incorrectly excludes prior service for 338 re-hired employees

Corrective Action Required

Engage external legal counsel to review variable pay documentation for identified employees and issue corrected award agreements within 60 days of this report.

Management Response

The condition identified has been partially remediated. Alaris Consulting has addressed the majority of the affected population and is on track for full closure by the due date. A status update will be provided at the next scheduled review.

Owner: Executive Assistant to the CEO • Due: 2022-10-28
WDR-5277-005LOWMONITORING
Observation

ADEA waiver and release agreements for 338 separating employees lack required OWBPA language

Corrective Action Required

The Total Rewards team will conduct a comprehensive review of all job postings to ensure salary range information is included where required by law, with a target of 100% compliance within 60 days.

Management Response

The finding is valid. A budget of $338K has been approved to procure the necessary technology to automate this control. Implementation is projected to take 28 weeks.

Owner: Director of Channel Partnerships • Due: 2022-10-28
WDR-4601-006MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

EEO-1 Component 2 data submission contains statistically improbable values for 338 job categories

Corrective Action Required

The company will engage an independent auditor to conduct a bias audit of its automated hiring tools before the statutory deadline for NYC Local Law 144.

Management Response

We concur. A project charter has been approved to address this finding. The project manager has been assigned, and a kickoff meeting is scheduled for 2022-06-16.

Owner: Chief Diversity Officer • Due: 2022-09-28
WDR-3565-007MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

Stock option grant approval dates do not align with board meeting minutes for 338 awards

Corrective Action Required

Conduct a privileged pay equity analysis under the direction of outside counsel to identify and remediate any statistically significant pay disparities based on gender or race/ethnicity.

Management Response

This finding has been superseded by a subsequent internal audit finding which addresses the same root cause with a more comprehensive corrective action plan. We request this finding be closed and tracked under the new internal audit reference number.

Owner: Risk Analyst • Due: 2022-08-28
